messages.content:
Risk: Violence
Description: Promoting or describing physical harm to individuals or groups. This includes depictions of assault, self-harm, or creation of a hostile environment through threats or intimidation.
Concern: None
Policy: Self Harm

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ThreatsOfViolence: Threats of Violence — Communication of intent to inflict harm or damage to create fear, even if not carried out. [found by 4/6 queries]
  Siblings: Homicide, Glorification of Violence, Weapons Use
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Intimidation: Intimidation — Use of threats or fear to coerce compliance or silence opposition without necessarily specifying lethal harm. [found by 3/6 queries]
  Siblings: Death Threat, Stalking
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0048.002: Societal Harm - ATLAS — Societal harms might generate harmful outcomes that reach either the general public or specific vulnerable groups such as the exposure of children to vulgar content. [found by 3/6 queries]
  Siblings: User Harm - ATLAS, Reputational Harm - ATLAS, Financial Harm - ATLAS
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 3/6 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeathThreat: Death Threat — Explicit communication of intent to kill a specific individual or group. [found by 3/6 queries]
  Siblings: Intimidation, Stalking

axes.rationale: The risk of violence is often communicated through threats, which are a direct way of describing or promoting physical harm.
Intimidation is a means by which violence is promoted or described, as it involves creating a hostile environment through threats or fear.
